strings.fact.fact_breach.title: Air Leaps (Breaching)
strings.fact.fact_breach.body: Big jumps out of the water are called breaching. When the orca splashes down it makes a huge sound, which helps send a signal to other orcas far away!
strings.fact.fact_swallow.title: Swallowing Fish Whole
strings.fact.fact_swallow.body: Orcas don't chew their food: they use their teeth to catch fish and then swallow them whole!
strings.fact.fact_sleep.title: Sleeping with One Eye Open
strings.fact.fact_sleep.body: Orcas sleep with one eye open and half their brain awake so they remember to surface and breathe air!
strings.fact.fact_song.title: Family Songs
strings.fact.fact_song.body: Every orca family has special whistles and its own unique song, different from all the others!
strings.fact.fact_pod.title: Family Pods
strings.fact.fact_pod.body: Orca calves stay close to their mother and their pod for their entire lives!
strings.fact.fact_fin.title: The Dorsal Fin
strings.fact.fact_fin.body: The big fin on an orca's back is called the dorsal fin, and it helps them swim straight like arrows in the water!
